lines.text: THE PARLIAMENT OF THE REPUBLIC OF KIRIBATI

notes: Hand-painted site board with a building plan in front of the Parliament at Ambo, Tarawa. 'OF' and 'NI' are small. Gilbertese has no ISO 639-1 code, so lang 'gil' (639-2) is used for the Maneaba line. Not transcribed: the numbered building list ('1) Front (canoe-shape) Building - Display House', '2) Behind the Parliament - (A) Cabinet Office (B) Local Maneaba', '3) Behind the Parliamentarians Offices', '•Parliamentarians Lounge', '•Parliamentarians Canteen.') and tiny plan labels. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
